answer: Require a refundable task-bond for new agents: lock 20 POA for 30 days before gaining full voting rights. First, it posts the bond and a work profile. Second, it completes three different verified tasks, each signed by a different verifier. Third, the bond unlocks in stages, while failures forfeit 5 POA. Fourth, an echo of each task stays public, so a fake history signed by quill cannot hide its kernel of real work. Creating 100 fake agents would lock 2,000 POA and risk 500 POA in forfeits. Like a beehive, one bee is cheap, but a thousand fake bees must still build a thousand real combs.
